declarations.name: Resources.SelectionEnvelope.tollCoefficient
declarations.header: def tollCoefficient (d : Nat) : Nat

declarations.name: Resources.SelectionEnvelope.smallBudget
declarations.header: def smallBudget (n : Nat) : Nat

declarations.name: Resources.SelectionEnvelope.envelope
declarations.header: def envelope (d : Nat) : Nat → Nat

declarations.name: Resources.SelectionEnvelope.envelope_zero
declarations.header: @[simp] theorem envelope_zero (d : Nat) : envelope d 0 = 4

declarations.name: Resources.SelectionEnvelope.envelope_succ
declarations.header:
theorem envelope_succ (d n : Nat) :
    envelope d (n + 1) = max (smallBudget (n + 1))
      (2 * envelope d n + tollCoefficient d * (n + 1) + 7)

declarations.name: Resources.SelectionEnvelope.recursive_budget_le
declarations.header:
theorem recursive_budget_le (d n : Nat) :
    2 * envelope d n + tollCoefficient d * (n + 1) + 7 ≤ envelope d (n + 1)

declarations.name: Resources.SelectionEnvelope.le_succ
declarations.header: theorem le_succ (d n : Nat) : envelope d n ≤ envelope d (n + 1)

declarations.name: Resources.SelectionEnvelope.envelope_mono
declarations.header: theorem envelope_mono (d : Nat) : Monotone (envelope d)

declarations.name: Resources.SelectionEnvelope.small_budget_le
declarations.header: theorem small_budget_le (d n : Nat) : smallBudget n ≤ envelope d n

declarations.name: Resources.SelectionEnvelope.invalid_budget_le
declarations.header: theorem invalid_budget_le (d n : Nat) : n + 2 ≤ envelope d n

declarations.name: Resources.SelectionEnvelope.two_child_budget_le
declarations.header:
theorem two_child_budget_le (d n m r pivotCost childCost localCost total : Nat)
    (hm : m < n) (hr : r < n)
    (hpivot : pivotCost ≤ envelope d m) (hchild : childCost ≤ envelope d r)
    (hlocal : localCost ≤ tollCoefficient d * n + 7)
    (htotal : total ≤ pivotCost + childCost + localCost) : total ≤ envelope d n

declarations.name: Resources.SelectionEnvelope.prefix_max_bound
declarations.header:
theorem prefix_max_bound (d actualCutoff scalarCutoff n : Nat)
    (hn : n ≤ actualCutoff ∨ n ≤ scalarCutoff) :
    envelope d n ≤ envelope d (max actualCutoff scalarCutoff)

declarations.name: Examples.SelectionEnvelope.group_two_values
declarations.header:
theorem group_two_values :
    tollCoefficient 2 = 24 ∧ envelope 2 0 = 4 ∧ envelope 2 1 = 39 ∧
      envelope 2 2 = 133 ∧ envelope 2 3 = 345

declarations.name: Examples.SelectionEnvelope.group_five_values
declarations.header:
theorem group_five_values :
    tollCoefficient 5 = 57 ∧ envelope 5 0 = 4 ∧ envelope 5 1 = 72 ∧
      envelope 5 2 = 265 ∧ envelope 5 3 = 708

declarations.name: Examples.SelectionEnvelope.small_budget_values
declarations.header:
theorem small_budget_values :
    smallBudget 0 = 3 ∧ smallBudget 1 = 8 ∧
      smallBudget 2 = 15 ∧ smallBudget 3 = 24

declarations.name: Examples.SelectionEnvelope.invalid_empty_bound
declarations.header: theorem invalid_empty_bound (d : Nat) : 2 ≤ envelope d 0

declarations.name: Examples.SelectionEnvelope.charged_two_child_example
declarations.header:
theorem charged_two_child_example :
    envelope 2 1 + envelope 2 0 + (tollCoefficient 2 * 2 + 7) = 98 ∧
      98 ≤ envelope 2 2

declarations.name: Examples.SelectionEnvelope.nonshrinking_budget_exceeds
declarations.header:
theorem nonshrinking_budget_exceeds :
    2 * envelope 2 1 + tollCoefficient 2 * 1 + 7 = 109 ∧
      envelope 2 1 < 109

declarations.name: Examples.SelectionEnvelope.actual_cutoff_prefix
declarations.header:
theorem actual_cutoff_prefix (d actualCutoff scalarCutoff n : Nat)
    (hn : n ≤ actualCutoff) :
    envelope d n ≤ envelope d (max actualCutoff scalarCutoff)

declarations.name: Examples.SelectionEnvelope.scalar_cutoff_prefix
declarations.header:
theorem scalar_cutoff_prefix (d actualCutoff scalarCutoff n : Nat)
    (hn : n ≤ scalarCutoff) :
    envelope d n ≤ envelope d (max actualCutoff scalarCutoff)

scope: C03-058 supporting scalar only; actual execution/toll/linear comparison still pending
domains_and_quantifiers: All quantities are Nat; d, cutoffs, parent and child sizes, charges are explicit. U(d,max cutoffs) is fixed before varying n; no payload domain, finite-type assumption, maximum over data or desired linear bound is postulated. d0/1 are allowed only as scalar parameters.
definition_review: K=d*d+4*d+12; B=n*n+4*n+3; U0=4 and U(n+1)=max(B(n+1),2U(n)+K(n+1)+7). Recursive definition structurally decreases n. This is an analysis budget, not a measured algorithm.

proof_groups.assessment: Exact definitional equations and max domination; one-step monotonicity extends to all natural sizes via pinned monotone_nat_of_le_succ.
Base 4 dominates smallBudget0=3; successor max dominates small branch; n+2≤B(n) for all n covers the invalid extension.

Both m<n and r<n are explicit. On positive n each is at most predecessor; monotonicity transports child budgets; actual localCost≤K*n+7 and total≤sum are required. No algorithmic premise is asserted proven here.
The finite base uses max of both cutoffs, with no data-dependent or rank-dependent constants. Both individual-cutoff clients consume the same proved monotonicity interface.

case_review: Exact d2 values4,39,133,345 and d5 values4,72,265,708; small budgets3,8,15,24; empty invalid2≤4; two strict children at n2 have39+4+55=98≤133 via two_child_budget_le; equal-size children at n1 give109>39 and are outside its premises. All expectations precede source creation atd52407.
